verdict.rationale: The SDK's hosting docs only describe deploying the orchestration layer (subprocess, Docker/Kubernetes) around a claude CLI subprocess that still calls Anthropic's hosted Claude API for the actual model inference — there is no evidence of a self-hostable model/core service, and community comments confirm usage is tied to Anthropic's API/subscription terms rather than an independently self-hostable core. Missing for 10: any documentation of running the core LLM/service independently of Anthropic's cloud API, open weights, or a fully offline deployment mode.
